source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Measure sequential read bandwidth/IOPS with CrystalDiskMark on Windows.
procedure_facts: Install CrystalDiskMark, run its GUI and check read/write result.
No drive, test size/count, profile, queue/thread setting or read-only control is defined.
source_conflicts: Items restrict the test to sequential read, while the procedure asks to check read/write and a default CrystalDiskMark run may write.
missing_source_information: Windows/tool version, exact sequential profile and read-only method.
Persistent target identity, free-space/test-file policy, cache/preconditioning and numeric threshold.

original_test_intent.statement: A Windows operator measures sequential-read bandwidth/IOPS on one approved SSD with CrystalDiskMark and records GUI evidence for comparison with a matching specification; writes are not authorized until the source conflict is resolved.
must_preserve: CrystalDiskMark on Windows, sequential read and operator-visible result.
must_not_infer: Permission to run the default read/write suite.
That OS CLI evidence replaces the GUI result.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly maps GUI execution to MANUAL ONLY, warns default suite can write and requires target/profile, screenshot/export, version and drive identity.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not elevate read-only title versus read/write procedure as SOURCE_CONFLICT or require proof that the selected CrystalDiskMark profile emits sequential-read IOPS as requested rather than only MB/s.

related_records: fio or other storage benchmarks cannot substitute for CrystalDiskMark GUI evidence.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Manual-only automation boundary remains; contradictory write scope requires source owner correction.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: A Windows operator can perform the test, but must not click the default suite until read-only versus read/write is resolved and the target/profile/spec are frozen.

conditions_present: Windows GUI tool and sequential-read intent are known.
missing: Write-scope decision, target, CDM version/profile/test size/count, IOPS/BW units, cache/media state, threshold and evidence method.
provider: Storage test owner resolves read/write scope and profile.
Storage owner designates target and accepts any test-file writes.
safe_read_only_work: Record Windows build, CDM version/hash, drive model/serial/firmware/capacity/controller and current health without launching a benchmark.
prohibited_until_resolved: Install/run suite, select target, create/delete test files, write, clear logs or PASS.
closure_evidence: Operator evidence plan captures settings and result table.

revision_candidate.purpose: Have a qualified Windows operator run the approved CrystalDiskMark sequential-read-only profile on one designated SSD, record bandwidth and IOPS evidence with all settings, and compare it with the matching storage specification.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact Windows build, CrystalDiskMark version/build, SSD/controller/firmware/driver and cache/media state. This remains GUI/manual unless an separately validated supported CLI/profile is provided.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One persistent drive identity and one signed sequential-read profile with exact block, queue/thread, test size and count. Do not run write tests or the default all-test suite unless the testcase is formally revised and destructive/write approval is granted.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Read/write correction; CDM installer/hash/license; drive identity; sequential profile/test size/count/units; free-space/test-file/cache/preconditioning policy; numeric BW/IOPS/latency criteria; screenshot/export naming; any write approval and cleanup.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Operator verifies drive identity and settings in the GUI, selects only the approved sequential-read test, captures the full pre-run configuration, starts once, waits for all requested read measurements, saves unedited screenshot/export and health/log evidence, and removes test files only under policy. Agent may organize evidence but cannot claim GUI actions.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflict resolved; operator present; target/spec/profile confirmed; tool trusted; sufficient free space/power; no production workload; any test-file creation approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Windows/CDM identity and hash; drive serial/model/firmware/controller/health; screenshot of selected drive and every profile setting; start/end times; complete sequential read MB/s and IOPS (and latency if shown); raw export; system/storage logs; cleanup and final health; operator attestation.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed specification for the same drive/controller/firmware, CrystalDiskMark version and exact sequential-read profile. Pass requires all requested read metrics meet thresholds with no disallowed errors; read/write default-suite output is not equivalent.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not choose OS/production drive by label alone, run write/all tests, change cache/power settings, overwrite evidence, infer missing IOPS, automate unsupported GUI clicks, clear logs or claim visual verification by an Agent.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Test owner resolves scope; storage owner approves target/test files; Windows operator performs and attests GUI actions; engineer judges result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical/GUI selection and observation are manual. Agent may pre-stage approved package, collect OS inventory and package evidence only where authorized.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on wrong drive/profile, unexpected write, error or instability; preserve screenshot/logs, close CDM, remove only known test files under approval and verify drive/OS health.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Scope/target/profile/spec/operator/approval missing; wrong drive or write test selected; settings drift; storage error, free-space/thermal/health limit, system instability, evidence loss or cleanup uncertainty.

identified_defects: Sequential-read title conflicts with read/write procedure.
GUI boundary and write risk are not defined by source.
reason_for_change: Preserve manual GUI execution while preventing an unauthorized default write suite from replacing the named sequential-read test.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Storage-00021-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: Sequential-read item, generic read/write GUI procedure and 20/30-minute values.

removed_ambiguities: Separates sequential read from default read/write suite.
Defines GUI evidence and agent/manual boundary.
resolved_blockers: Manual execution remains possible after owner inputs.
remaining_blockers: Source scope conflict and operator handoff must close.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 treats the read-only title versus read/write GUI instruction as a source conflict, then requires settings-screen proof that the operator selected the exact sequential test before any result can be accepted.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Manual-only boundary and write prohibition are explicit; no GUI or DUT validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 10 names sequential read but tells the operator to check read/write in CDM.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 identifies GUI/write risk; V3 elevates source conflict and requires profile-screen proof and read IOPS evidence.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Inventory only until scope/target/profile/operator approvals close.
